### `dev.explain_node` — Explain This Node

Explains any node in the inspector: what the component does, how its props are set, what it is bound to.

**Why it exists.** Reading someone else's scene should not require reading the component reference.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `ask` — A popover answers questions about the element or screen. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | string | yes |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("dev.explain_node")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.explain_node", {"target": "send", "scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Contact"}, "children": [{"type": "Form", "id": "contact", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}, "on": {"…": "1 keys"}, "children": [{"…": "3 keys"}, {"…": "3 keys"}]}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "title": "Button #send",
  "body": "Action trigger.",
  "bullets": [
    "label = \"Send message\"",
    "variant = \"primary\""
  ],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "tone": "info"
}
```

### `dev.ux_review` — Heuristic UX Review

Reviews a scene against usability heuristics and returns scored findings with fixes.

**Why it exists.** Design review is the bottleneck of every UI team; a first pass should be instant.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | hybrid: the engine computes the facts, the model writes the narrative |
| Model tier | balanced |
| Surface | `audit` — A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `score` | number |
| `summary` | string |
| `findings` | list of object {id, severity, title, detail, target, fix} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("dev.ux_review")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.ux_review", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": ""}, "children": [{"type": "Input", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Button", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Button", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "score": 74.0,
  "summary": "5 usability findings: 0 blocking, 4 to improve.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "ux.orientation",
      "severity": "warning",
      "title": "No page title",
      "detail": "People cannot tell where they are without a title or heading.",
      "target": "_r",
      "fix": "Give the page a title that names the task."
    },
    {
      "id": "ux.single-primary",
      "severity": "warning",
      "title": "Competing primary actions",
      "detail": "2 primary buttons share one region (OK, Delete account).",
      "target": "_r.2",
      "fix": "Keep one primary action; demote the others to secondary."
    },
    {
      "id": "ux.label",
      "severity": "warning",
      "title": "Field without a label",
      "detail": "Placeholder text disappears on input and is not a label.",
      "target": "_r.0",
      "fix": "Add label “Type here”."
    },
    "… 2 more"
  ]
}
```

### `dev.test_synth` — Test Synthesis

Generates Autopilot interaction tests from a scene: fill every field, press every action, assert the event.

**Why it exists.** UI tests are written last and least; deriving them from the scene makes coverage the default.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `cases` | list of object {name, steps} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.test_synth", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Contact"}, "children": [{"type": "Form", "id": "contact", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}, "on": {"…": "1 keys"}, "children": [{"…": "3 keys"}, {"…": "3 keys"}]}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "fills and submits contact",
      "steps": [
        {
          "…": "3 keys"
        },
        {
          "…": "3 keys"
        },
        {
          "…": "3 keys"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `dev.fixtures` — Fixture Generator

Produces realistic, deterministic sample data for a list of fields or a JSON Schema.

**Why it exists.** Screens designed against “Lorem ipsum” break on real names, long emails and large numbers.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` | any | yes |
| `count` | integer | no |
| `seed` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `rows` | JSON value |
| `count` | integer |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.fixtures", {"fields": ["name", "email", "plan", "… 1 more"], "count": 3})
```

### `dev.transpose` — Scene-to-Code in 14 Languages

### `dev.port` — Cross-Language Porting

Ports a Fluidian application — view and handlers — from one supported language to another.

**Why it exists.** Teams change stacks; the interface definition should move with them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | deep |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes |
| `from` | one of `python`, `javascript`, `typescript`, `go`, `rust`, `java`, `kotlin`, `csharp`, `cpp`, `ruby`, `php`, `dart`, `elixir`, `lua` | yes |
| `to` | one of `python`, `javascript`, `typescript`, `go`, `rust`, `java`, `kotlin`, `csharp`, `cpp`, `ruby`, `php`, `dart`, `elixir`, `lua` | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `code` | string |
| `notes` | list of string |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.port", {"source": "app.on('increment', (ctx) => { ctx.state.count = (ctx.state.count || 0) + 1 })", "from": "javascript", "to": "rust"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "code": "use fluidian::{jarr, jobj, ui, App, Json};\n\nfn main() {\n    let mut app = App::new(\"Ported app\");\n    app.view(|_ctx| {\n        ui::page(…",
  "notes": [
    "Offline: produced the rust application skeleton; handler logic needs the Reason path to be ported automatically.",
    "State lives in ctx.state in every SDK; handler names are unchanged across languages."
  ]
}
```

### `dev.scene_lint` — Scene Lint

```python
# or call it from a handler
```

**Why it exists.** JSON diffs of UI trees are unreadable; reviewers need “the Save button moved into the toolbar”.


| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `score` | number |
| `summary` | string |
| `findings` | list of object {id, severity, title, detail, target, fix} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("dev.perf_hint")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("dev.perf_hint", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Big"}, "children": [{"type": "Image", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Table", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```
